description: Check a domain's email authentication: SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI. $0.01 USDC on Base per call. Returns SPF validity and lookup count (limit 10), DMARC policy/pct/rua, DKIM on common selectors, MTA-STS mode, TLS-RPT, BIMI, a rough 0-100 score and plain-English findings. Don't use this for DKIM on custom selectors; only common selectors are checked. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
name: orioncmd_email_auth
title: OrionCMD Checks: GET /v1/email-auth
